hardware_environment: Intel/AMD x86_64 CPU (PyTorch 2.15 CPU, single-thread reference)
benchmark_methodology: All metrics measured over 75 evaluations across 5 distinct sentence contexts. Timing uses high-resolution time.perf_counter() with warm cache. Forward-pass measures torch.no_grad() PyTorch model forward pass. Candidate extraction measures top-100 BPE decoding and whole-word candidate deduplication. Full service latency encompasses tokenization, model forward pass, candidate extraction, and Pydantic object construction.
